text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Power is overflowing through my body...!? 
What's going on!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Could it be? Did the Three Goddesses 
hear what was said just now...? As if 
saying, 'Surpass it if you can'—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. In that case— why don't I show you 
that I can live up to those expectations!
